frases.en: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
frases.es: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.

frases.en: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
frases.es: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

frases.es: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

frases.en: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
frases.es: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

frases.en: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families,

frases.en: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.

frases.en: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
frases.es: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.

frases.en: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD.
frases.es: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD.

frases.en: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah, And Resen between Nineveh and Calah:
frases.es: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah, And Resen between Nineveh and Calah:

frases.es: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim, And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,)

frases.en: and the Arkite, and the Sinite, And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite:
frases.es: and the Arkite, and the Sinite, And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite:

frases.es: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.

frases.en: and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.
frases.es: and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.

frases.en: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.
frases.es: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.

frases.en: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.
frases.es: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.

frases.en: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.
frases.es: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.

frases.en: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.
frases.es: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.

frases.es: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.

frases.en: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided;
frases.es: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided;

frases.en: and his brother’s name was Joktan.
frases.es: and his brother’s name was Joktan.

frases.en: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazar-maveth, and Jerah, And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah, And Obal, and Abimael,
frases.es: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazar-maveth, and Jerah, And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah, And Obal, and Abimael,

frases.en: and Sheba, And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.
frases.es: and Sheba, And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.

frases.en: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.
frases.es: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.

frases.en: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.
frases.es: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.

frases.en: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations:
frases.es: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations:

frases.en: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
frases.es: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.

frases.en: So what does this chapter mean? Here are three simple ideas.
frases.es: ¿Y qué quiere decir este capítulo? Acá van tres ideas simples.

frases.en: First: this is a list of families. In the Bible, a family tree shows where peoples and places came from.
frases.es: Primera: es una lista de familias. En la Biblia, un árbol genealógico muestra de dónde vienen los pueblos y los lugares.

frases.en: Second: the list says all the nations of the earth come from one family, the sons of Noah.
frases.es: Segunda: la lista dice que todas las naciones de la tierra vienen de una misma familia, los hijos de Noé.

frases.en: Third: the chapter ends with the nations spread across the earth. That sets up the next story.
frases.es: Tercera: el capítulo termina con las naciones repartidas por la tierra. Eso prepara la historia que sigue.

frases.en: One more thing: in the original Hebrew, a few words say even more.
frases.es: Una cosa más: en el hebreo original, algunas palabras dicen todavía más.

frases.en: The word for nations, in "the isles of the Gentiles," is goyim. It simply means peoples or nations.
frases.es: La palabra para naciones, en «las islas de las naciones», es goyim. Significa simplemente pueblos o naciones.

frases.en: The name Peleg means division. The text says the earth was divided in his days.
frases.es: El nombre Péleg significa división. El texto dice que en sus días la tierra fue dividida.

frases.en: And "begat" translates yalad, which means to bring forth, or to become the father of.
frases.es: Y «engendró» traduce yalad, que significa dar a luz o llegar a ser padre de.

frases.en: The families are spread across the earth. Yet the text says they speak different tongues. What was the story behind that?
frases.es: Las familias se reparten por la tierra. Pero el texto dice que hablan lenguas distintas. ¿Cuál es la historia detrás?

frases.en: Next time: Genesis, Chapter 11. The tower of Babel.
frases.es: La próxima vez: Génesis, capítulo 11. La torre de Babel.

frases.en: Thank you for reading the Bible with me, one chapter at a time.
frases.es: Gracias por leer la Biblia conmigo, un capítulo a la vez.
